Haneda Airport — Terminal 3.do: Visit Japan Web QR open BEFORE the hall: one code now covers immigration AND the customs declaration, and Haneda's Electronic Customs Declaration gates read it — with 35 people the gap between everyone ready and half the group digging for phones is about fifteen minutes at 22:15. Regroup at the 2F arrivals meeting point; at 22:00 the terminal empties fast. Building open 24 h, info 03-5757-8111. Then the booked coach, 1.3 km and 5 minutes — there is no scheduled way in to the hotel at 22:30.
Haneda Airport — Terminal 3.eat: Air LAWSON, 1F Entrance Plaza, landside, one floor down from 2F arrivals and open 24 HOURS — hot food, onigiri, drinks, and the only reliable answer for a party off a 7h15 flight. CORRECTION: this is not a basement store; T3 has no B1 convenience store at all. Edo Koji's sushi, yakitori and oden counters on 4F-5F are shut by 22:00, the 3F airside Seven-Eleven runs 07:00-21:00 and the 2F departures one 06:00-23:30 — neither reachable by an arriving party. Matsuya at the hotel's block is 24 h.
Haneda Airport — Terminal 3.snack: Air LAWSON on 1F, 24 hours, is the whole answer and it is a real one: buy here rather than counting on the hotel block, because Daily Yamazaki beside the lobby shuts at 23:00 and the group lands at 21:55. No price is published on any page we hold, so budget rather than quote. Vending machines run through the terminal. Nothing else trades: the Japan Promenade souvenir street is 10:00-20:00 and its restaurants 11:00-22:00, so it is shut tonight and shut again before the morning coach.
Haneda Airport — Terminal 3.buy: Do not shop here, and the reason is arithmetic, not taste: Day 8 gives roughly three hours at Narita T1 with the airside Nakamise run on South Wing 3F, and that is where the chilled and heavy things belong — ROYCE' nama chocolate, Shiroi Koibito tins, anything needing an ice pack. At 21:55 the only retail open in T3 is Air LAWSON anyway. Haneda Airport Garden's 1F regional-souvenir street, T3-直結 by the 2F walkway, runs 10:00-20:00 and is shut at both ends of this night.
Haneda Airport — Terminal 3.see: The 5F rooftop observation deck — CORRECTION to the seed, it has NOT closed by the time you land: the airport's own service page lists T3's 5F deck as 開場時間24時間, the only Haneda deck open all night, since T1 and T2 both shut at 22:00. Landside, no ticket, escalators up from 2F arrivals past Edo Koji; it shuts without notice for wind. Take Edo Koji on the way — the mock-Edo street of shopfronts and paper lanterns is public at any hour, 6 minutes up, worth it even shuttered.

Added the airside/landside store hours the seed's 'the terminal konbini' glosses over: 3F airside Seven-Eleven 07:00-21:00, 2F departures 06:00-23:30, Edo Koji's restaurants closing about 22:00 (day1-haneda essentials.closedNote).

Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Haneda.do: RENAMED IN PLACE on 4 Sep: same property, same Haneda Innovation City Zone A address, same phone — HOTEL METROPOLITAN TOKYO HANEDA is JR East's official English name. Arrival is about 22:50-23:15 once bags clear, so do the one thing that works at any hour: THE ROOFTOP, roof floor, 24 hours, guests only with a card key, over Terminal 3 and the runways with Skytree and the Rainbow Bridge. Two operator rules: closed in rain, and TRIPODS AND STEPLADDERS ARE PROHIBITED. Reception 24 h, 03-3747-1101.
Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Haneda.eat: Matsuya at HICity Zone B 2F, 24 hours, ordered from a ticket machine, three minutes away — the only round-the-clock hot food on the site. It is not halal and it is beef and pork, so treat it as a fallback for whoever is still hungry rather than a group plan. Breakfast is il CIELO HANEDA on 5F: opens 06:00, LAST ENTRY 09:30, closes 10:00, ¥2,750 walk-in but in the package. Because it opens at 06:00 the 07:30 sitting can be pulled forward, which is the only way to buy a real pre-08:30 window.
Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Haneda.snack: Daily Yamazaki, HICity Zone A, one minute from the lobby, with an in-store bakery at about ¥150-350 — but the official weekday hours are 07:00-23:00, so a 23:00 arrival is a FIFTEEN-MINUTE window, not an open one. Say that on the coach before anyone unpacks. After 23:00 the only hot food is Matsuya, 24 h, three minutes. Nothing here survives to Malaysia; this is tonight's supper and tomorrow's coach snack, and the shop keeps weekend hours of 09:00-17:00 for anyone checking the wrong table.
Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Haneda.buy: The one genuine take-home is Anamori Inari's goshinsuna — sacred sand from the Inariyama mound at the Okunomiya, traditionally scattered at a doorway or carried for safe travel. Weightless, flight-safe, no shelf life. The shrine is 8 minutes on foot along Kanpachi-dori and its grounds are 24時間参拝可能, so a pre-08:30 walk works — but the office is 09:00-16:00, so this is a self-serve pickup at the mound with no published price: leave a coin. Otherwise only Daily Yamazaki, 07:00-23:00 weekdays.
Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Haneda.see: The Ashiyu Sky Deck on the Zone E rooftop, five minutes away: a FREE open-air footbath with an unobstructed, fence-free view straight down Haneda's B runway, HICity hours 05:30-23:30. Sit on the FAR side of the bath, away from the building, so the runway is ahead of you and no fence is in frame. A 23:00 arrival leaves about 25 minutes, so go straight there rather than waiting for room keys — or take it from 05:30. Towels are SOLD on site, not provided: ¥500 in coins.

Added what the 30-minute radius bought for the pre-08:30 window, since the seed offers only the footbath: Anamori Inari's sen-bon torii and Okunomiya 8-9 minutes away (grounds 24 h, office 09:00-16:00, so no goshuin), the 2.0 km Soramunade Haneda Ryokuchi riverside walkway 11 minutes out with an aircraft terrace, and the 1929 Haneda Grand Torii 5 minutes away on the promenade, its plaque reading 平和 (expand-d12 d1w30hma/hmb/hmc, day1-haneda 052699865bda).

Tokyo Station.do: Fifty minutes, 09:15-10:05, almost all INSIDE the gates, and the order is fixed by what is open. Ekiben FIRST at Ekibenya Matsuri, Gransta Tokyo 1F Central Passage inside the gates, 05:30-22:00, 150種類以上, tel 03-3213-4353 — the one unit certain to be trading at 09:15. Then the Marunouchi domes. Use Ginnosuzu, the Silver Bell Square on Gransta B1, as the head-count point: the station's own designated rally spot. On the platform by 09:50 — a 35-person reserved block boards as one.
Tokyo Station.eat: Gyuniku Domannaka by Shinkineya of Yonezawa, ¥1,620 — soy-simmered Yonezawa beef with beef soboro over rice, the perennial No.1 at Ekibenya Matsuri, eaten on the 10:05 Tohoku Shinkansen rather than in the station. That ekiben IS the meal here: Gransta's restaurants run 10:00-22:00 and open after the group has gone, while the bento and sweets counters trade from 08:00. The ¥1,620 is seed-level — the shop's own Gransta page 404s — so treat it as the last published figure, not a 2026 quote.
Tokyo Station.snack: The bento and sweets counters from 08:00 are the entire standing-food answer inside the gates, and Ekibenya Matsuri from 05:30 is the reliable one — buying there covers the snack and the Shinkansen meal in one queue, which is what 35 people and 50 minutes need. Nothing else trades: Gransta's 雑貨・コスメ units are 全日 10:00-21:00 and its restaurants 10:00-22:00. Coins for the platform kiosks, and the Tohoku Shinkansen platforms are at the YAESU end, so you cross the Central Passage twice.
Tokyo Station.buy: THE ANSWER THE SEED DOES NOT HAVE: Maruzen Marunouchi Main Store, 1F-4F of Marunouchi Oazo, four minutes from the Central Passage, OPENS 09:00 and runs to 21:00 with no September closing day — about a million Japanese titles and 120,000 foreign-language, plus stationery; tel 03-5288-8881, tax-free at the till. Inside the gates the only travelling buy is (NO) RAISIN SANDWICH, caramel butter, ¥1,580 for four, a Tokyo-Station exclusive, from a sweets counter open at 08:00.
Tokyo Station.see: The restored 1914 Marunouchi domes: free, indoors, no hours to worry about — you walk through them. Eight zodiac reliefs at the octagon's diagonal corners, the four cardinal animals deliberately absent. Take the SOUTH dome — recorded as usually emptier, the better bet for 35 people wanting one ceiling shot. Stand in the CENTRE under the apex, back to the gates, shoot straight up. Do NOT go outside for the brick facade: the Marunouchi front faces WEST and at 09:15 sits in its own shadow.
correctedFromSeed: THE SEED DIAGNOSES THE PROBLEM AND MISSES THE ANSWER. Everything else in reach is shut in this window, which the seed does not say: KITTE, the KITTE Garden roof terrace, Intermediatheque and the Marunouchi Naka-dori shops all open 11:00; Naka-dori's pedestrian Urban Terrace is weekdays 11:00-15:00; Tokyo Midtown Yaesu is B1 10:00 and 1F-3F 11:00; Coredo Muromachi 10:00-11:00; Fukutoku Shrine's goshuin desk 10:00-17:00; and the Tokyo Station Gallery opens 10:00, five minutes after the group should be on the platform (d2w30tkb/tkc/tkd/tkj/tkl).

Both prices here are seed-level and flagged as such: (NO) RAISIN SANDWICH at ¥1,580 for four (the shop's own Gransta page 404s) and Gyuniku Domannaka at ¥1,620 with its top-seller ranking (d179bc1bcca5, 6939f7433f8f).

Added the rally point the seed omits: Ginnosuzu, the Silver Bell Square on Gransta B1 inside the gates — a named, signposted spot every Japanese guide knows, which is what a 35-person head-count before a reserved-seat Shinkansen actually needs (d2tok001giner).

The seed names 'the North and South gates' for the domes without choosing. Choose SOUTH: the batch records it as usually emptier, and the position is the centre of the octagon under the apex with your back to the gates (819125747a61, mustSee 9a4889e0da9f).

Two free things ARE open at 09:15 if the ekiben queue is short, and neither is in the seed: Tokyo International Forum's glass hall, 07:00-23:30, 年中無休, free public space nine minutes out; and the Imperial Palace outer garden with Wadakura Fountain Park, twelve minutes each way — which is 24 minutes of walking out of 50, so it is the honest edge of the slot rather than a plan (d2w30tke, d2w30tkf).

Nijubashi, the Imperial Palace East Gardens (free, 09:00-17:00, closed Mondays AND Fridays, so Wed 9 Sep is open) and Nihonbashi are all reachable on paper and all recorded as NOT fitting: 32, 26 and 24 minutes of walking respectively out of a 50-minute stop (d2w30tkg/tkh/tki).

Sendai Station.do: Twenty minutes, and a grab-and-go: the constraint is not hours but a 12:15 oyster lunch 29 km and 40 coach-minutes away. Walk the 3F Gyutan-dori and Sushi-dori arcades directly above the Shinkansen gates — six beef-tongue specialists side by side, all trading from 10:00, Date no Gyutan Honpo 10:00-21:30 (L.O. 21:00, no closing day, tel 022-715-5056; its opening moved to 10:00 in June 2024, which is why 11:40 works). Look, do not sit: a gyutan set is impossible even though the shops are open.
Sendai Station.eat: Zunda shake at Zunda Saryo's Zunda Komichi store on 3F — a sweet green-soybean milkshake drunk in three minutes, and edamame is at its seasonal peak in early September. Retail counter 09:00-21:00, café 10:00-18:30, tel 022-715-1081. Buy it LAST so it is still cold on the coach. The ¥420 short / ¥530 tall is the seed's figure and no batch record prices it, so quote it as indicative. Date no Gyutan's 牛たん弁当 is the version you can carry onto the coach; the 芯たん定食 is the house set and does not fit.
Sendai Station.snack: The zunda shake is the standing snack and the only one that fits: three minutes, 3F Zunda Komichi, retail counter open from 09:00. Everything chewable is out on the arcades: Abe Kamaboko Honten's hyotan-age — sasa-kamaboko in sweet batter deep-fried on a stick, ¥300, with a lottery attached — is on Clis Road, ten minutes each way, i.e. the whole stop; Sendai Asaichi's ¥150 zunda dango skewers are five minutes out, and its ¥500 asa-ramen is a 07:00-10:00 item, gone by 11:40.
Sendai Station.buy: Omiyage-dokoro Sendai No.3, 2F west, 07:00-21:00, tel 022-267-1965 — a JR East LiViT shop, so those are the operator's own hours, and it is open right through 11:40, unlike anything at Tokyo Station. Hagi no Tsuki by Kasho Sanzen, 6-piece box ¥1,590, 常温保存 with about 14 days of shelf life, so it clears an eight-day trip with room. Kikufuku's zunda cream daifuku tastes better and ships FROZEN, so it will not fly. If the 20 minutes evaporates, the same ¥1,590 box is on sale in Matsushima at 14:20.
Sendai Station.see: Aoba-dori from the 2F West Exit pedestrian deck — a straight green tunnel of zelkova running almost due west, the avenue that earns Sendai the name Mori no Miyako, fully leafed on 9 September: a SUMMER-green picture, not an autumn one. Stand at the WEST rail on the deck's centre line looking down the axis; at 11:40 the sun is high and slightly behind your left shoulder, so expose for the road and let the canopy go dark. Four minutes each way. CHECK FIRST: the deck has had recurring hoardings.
correctedFromSeed: THE SEED'S AOBA-DORI COORDINATE WAS IN THE PACIFIC. It held 35.926, 140.882 — off Chiba. Replaced with the government gazetteer's own point for 青葉通 (7a27a1e1055d). Added the free thing that actually fits and the seed does not have: the AER Observation Terrace on the 31F of the 145.5 m AER tower at 中央1-3-1, free, 10:00-20:00, two minutes from the 2F west deck — open at 11:40, east and west terraces over Sendai's grid, the Hirose valley and the Zao ridge. The lifts are the bottleneck for 35 people (expand-d12 d2w30sna).
The zunda shake's ¥420/¥530 is seed-level: the batch record for Zunda Saryo carries the shop, the hours and the three-minute drink but no price (a1d972705ada).

Aji Tasuke Honten, the 1948 shop that invented Sendai gyutan (11:30-20:30, closed Tuesdays, so Wed 9 Sep is fine), is recorded as NOT IN THIS SLOT: 36 minutes of walking plus a 45-minute sit-down against a 20-35 minute stop. The 3F arcade is the substitute and is already in the plan (d2w30snh).

Added the covered-arcade chain the seed does not mention, which matters in September heat and rain: Hapina Nakakecho 198.6 m straight out of the west exit, then Clis Road 284 m, then Marble Road Omachi, Brandome and Sunmall Ichibancho — units from 10:00, so open at 11:40, but 26 minutes of walking to reach the department-store belt (d2w30snb/snc/sng).

Iroha Yokocho, the nearly eighty-year-old post-war alley at 一番町2-3-28, is MOSTLY A NIGHT PLACE: hours are 店舗による and at midday a large share of the shutters are down, so a 12:00 visit is a photograph of an empty lane (d2w30snf).

Rikyu's Sendai Station branch hours could not be confirmed — the chain's own store list redirect-loops from this sandbox — so only the arcade's 10:00 opening is carried for it (7021796b2233, notes2 §6.8).

Matsushima Fish Market.do: One hour, 13:18-14:18. Order at a 1F counter and carry your own tray up to the 2F hall — the only sit-down room in the building. Watch the weekday clock: market 09:00-16:00, the 1F sushi and don counter takes orders 09:00-15:00, the 別館 Yakigaki House and the 2F hall 10:00-15:00, and 15:00 is a hard cut-off, not a last order. Parking is free for cars and 大型自動車 — LARGE COACHES ARE EXPLICITLY ACCEPTED. Tel 022-353-2318. Zuiganji is 450 m and 7 minutes on.
Matsushima Fish Market.eat: PRICES CORRECTED against the market's own menu. The kaki burger is ¥600, not ¥380 — the market's own invention, a breaded oyster patty in a bun, and COOKED, which is the honest September oyster. Tuna bowls start at ねぎとろ丼 ¥1,300 and run to 昭福丸まぐろ大漁丼 ¥2,400 and 極上海鮮丼 ¥3,900, cut from the market's own six Kesennuma longliners. 生うに丼 ¥3,950 is April-to-end-August only, so it is gone. Lunch was at 12:15, so eat light: the 2F しょうゆラーメンミニ at ¥600 is the small fallback.
Matsushima Fish Market.snack: A stand-and-eat market, and the ¥600 kaki burger in the hand is the answer. Know what the annex is before anyone commits: the 別館 Yakigaki House's 45-minute 焼がき食べ放題 is ¥3,500, or ¥4,000 with kaki rice and soup, the grills ARE lit on a weekday at 13:18 — and 「お席のご予約は承っておりません」, seats cannot be booked at all, so 35 people queue as walk-ins for a 45-minute sitting inside a 60-minute stop. Phone first: 9 Sep is outside the Nov-Mar season the operator itself flags.
Matsushima Fish Market.buy: Kaki-shoyu, oyster soy sauce, from the 1F souvenir wall at about ¥700 — shelf-stable and sealed, the honest way to take September Matsushima oyster flavour home. But it is a LIQUID, so it rides in the 25 kg checked bag, not the 7 kg cabin one. Sanriku Kaiho-zuke is the other named preserve and Sanriku wakame is the lighter, cabin-safe alternative. No official page prices the souvenir wall, so ¥700 is a typical bottle rather than a quote. Cash in small notes.
Matsushima Fish Market.see: Whole tuna with the collar and cheek cuts laid out on ice at the 1F counter, landed by the market's own Kesennuma fleet. Stand at the LEFT-REAR corner of the 1F sushi and don counter with the ice bed between you and the fishmongers — the only angle that gets whole fish, price cards and a server's hands in one frame without shooting over other customers. Mixed door daylight against fluorescent over wet ice: set white balance by hand or it all goes green. And the annex grills are LIT, not idle.
correctedFromSeed: THE KAKI BURGER IS ¥600, not the seed's ¥380 — the market's own menu. The ¥380 survives only on tourism-portal pages (day2-matsushima f017d1965514).
The maguro-don range is ¥1,300-2,400, rising to ¥3,900 for 極上海鮮丼, not the seed's ¥750-2,400; and 生うに丼 at ¥3,950 is a 4月〜8月末 item, so it is off the menu on 9 Sep (efa7e3c31a7d).

The seed's 'food last orders around 15:00' is sharpened: on a weekday the 1F counter is 09:00-15:00 while the annex and the 2F hall are 10:00-15:00, and 15:00 is a hard close (essentials.closedNote).

Added the 2F ramen counter — the only sit-down room, all 1F food carried up self-service — with しょうゆラーメンミニ ¥600 as the cheap fallback for anyone who ate the 12:15 oyster set, plus かきラーメン ¥1,500 and ふかひれラーメン ¥2,200 (d2fis001ramen).

Added the best unused thing on the peninsula, two minutes away at 普賢堂13-13: the Michinoku Date Masamune Historical Museum, about 200 life-size waxworks, ¥1,000 adult / ¥500 child / ¥300 school groups, 09:00-17:00 with last admission 16:30, 無休, capacity 300, allow 30 minutes — it fits this hour only if lunch is a stand-up kaki burger (expand-d12 d2w30fma).

Zuiganji Temple.do: One hour, one order, because the three things sit 200 m apart and the light dictates the sequence: cave tombs at 14:20 while the group is together and the shade is even, then the Hondo, then the Seiryuden treasure hall — furthest from the gate, nearest the 500 m walk to Godaido. Back at the gate by 15:14. Apr-Sep 08:30-17:00, last reception 16:30, no closing days. 「専用駐車場はありません」 — NO dedicated parking. Group rate ¥900 at 30+ against ¥1,000: book it, tel 022-354-2023.
Zuiganji Temple.eat: Zunda shake at Kasho Sanzen's Matsushima Teramachi-Koji store, 09:00-18:00, at 町内58 on the lane between the temple and Matsushima-Kaigan Station, with about 15 free car spaces — the one quick cold thing on the approach that works for 35 people. PRICE UNCONFIRMED: the seed's ¥360 is on no Kasho Sanzen page and one review quotes about ¥280, so budget rather than quote. Lunch was 12:15 and the market 13:18, so nobody needs food here — and the next kitchen is at Godaido at 15:22.
Zuiganji Temple.snack: Thin, and the honest version is that cold zunda shake at Kasho Sanzen, five minutes from the gate, 09:00-18:00, price unconfirmed. WE HOLD NO RECORD OF ANY STALL INSIDE THE GROUNDS. Three minutes away Tenrin-in is free and open 08:00-17:00 but sells no food; Entsuin next door at 町内67 is ¥400 a head at 15+ and closes 16:00. Anyone who wanted something hot should have bought it at the market. This is a shoes-off temple hour, not an eating one.
Zuiganji Temple.buy: The Zuiganji goshuin at ¥500, or the temple's own seal book at ¥1,200, from the desk by the Kuri exit — paper, flat, weightless, and the only souvenir here that is Zuiganji rather than generic Matsushima. Bring the ¥500 in coins, and note the desk sits past the Hondo, which a wheelchair cannot reach. Both prices are the seed's, published nowhere on the temple's site. Three minutes away Tenrin-in issues TWO seals, for Shaka Nyorai and the Iroha Kannon — free entry, no published price.
Zuiganji Temple.see: The Shitchu 'Peacock Room' in the Hondo — gold-leaf sliding doors painted with peacocks and pines, showpiece of the 2008-2018 restoration, and the originals of two Hondo rooms painted 1620-1622 are recreated in the treasure hall, so one ticket shows the room twice. CAVEAT: the temple warns some 障壁画 are 「期間を制限して公開」, so its state on 9 Sep is unknown. The sure frame is the tuff cave tombs on the approach, packed with weathered Buddhas: shoot ALONG the cliff on your left, never into a cave mouth.

The seed's ¥360 zunda shake at Kasho Sanzen Matsushima is UNCONFIRMED: no Kasho Sanzen page prices it and one review on the tourism-navi listing quotes about ¥280 (d2zui001sanzen, notes2 §6.3).

Two of the seed's confident statements are carried at medium instead: whether the Seiryuden treasure hall is inside the ¥1,000 ticket is nowhere stated in words on the temple's own pages, and whether the cave tombs sit inside or outside the ticket gate is likewise unstated (880a62f5b491, 4651cfb8ab4d).

Added the fix for the day's worst shopping squeeze: Hagi no Tsuki over the same Kasho Sanzen counter, the same ¥1,590 six-piece box with the same 14-day 常温 life, bought inside a one-hour temple stop instead of a 20-minute Shinkansen-gate dash at Sendai (d2sh001haginomatsu).

Added three neighbours the seed omits: Tenrin-in — free, 08:00-17:00, three minutes, Irohahime's temple with two goshuin; Entsuin at 町内67, 年中無休, Apr-Nov 09:00-16:00, ¥500 or ¥400 at 15+, Date Mitsumune's 1646 mausoleum with NO autumn colour before late October; and Yotokuin, which is 非公開 — walk up to the gate, the moss and the cedar, but do not promise the Megohime mausoleum (d2zui002entsu, d2w30zgb, d2w30zgc).

Also within 30 minutes and unused: Oshima island over the little red Togetsukyo, free and usually empty, Basho's first stop in Oku no Hosomichi with about fifty rock-cut niches and the Raiken monument; and the Miyagi Matsushima Rikyu rooftop deck by the station, ¥400 adult, 10:00-18:00, no closing day, parties of 20+ priced separately (d2w30zga, d2w30zgd).

Godaido Hall.do: Thirty minutes, free, 08:30-17:00, no closing day — and it is all outside, because the hall's five Myo statues are shown once every 33 years. Cross both vermilion sukashibashi, lattice-floored bridges showing the sea five metres below through the gaps, built so pilgrims had to watch their step. THE SHOE RULE IS ABSOLUTE: no heels, no open-toe, nothing that can drop through, no wheelchair — say it on the coach, there is no way round. The refurbishment completed 14 Mar 2025, so both are walkable.
Godaido Hall.eat: PRICES CORRECTED. Genzo's gyutan korokke is ¥400, not ¥350 — 10:30-16:30, 不定休, tel 022-354-0810, in the Matsushima Park green plaza at 町内110, literally at the Godaido entrance; its grilled oysters are ¥300-400 but seasonal and the kaki chowder is 夏季休止中. Pensee's oyster curry bread, 2020 Curry Bread Grand Prix gold and fried rather than raw, is ¥380 and it is NOT on this approach: it is on the 1F of Matsushima Rikyu Umi-no-Eki at 町内75-14, about 200 m from the pier.
Godaido Hall.snack: Genzo at the entrance, ¥400, one minute away, hot in the hand — the best-placed standing food of the day and it needs no queue management. The grill-your-own option is CORRECTED: Matsushima Kamaboko Honpo at 町内120 charges ¥400 a stick and PARTIES OF 10+ MUST PRE-BOOK it, so for 35 people use Abe Kamaboko's Matsushima Teramachi branch at 町内58 instead — ¥300 tax-in, about 10 minutes, 「予約は不要です」, three minutes on toward the pier and open 9:00-18:00.
Godaido Hall.buy: Sasakamaboko from Matsushima Kamaboko Honpo Sohonten, 町内120, 9:30-17:00 (Dec-Mar to 16:30), 定休日 なし, tel 022-354-4016 — about ¥300 a piece, and the shop opens 9:30, not the seed's 09:00. THE QUESTION TO ASK AT THE TILL: fresh kamaboko is chilled and does NOT survive the flight, and only the vacuum-packed shelf-stable line does. Which packs are which is not stated on the shop's site, so ask rather than guess — and the ¥300 is a tourism-feature figure, not the shop's own.
Godaido Hall.see: The classic Matsushima composition: pine-topped islets, the vermilion Fukuura bridge entering from the left, boats crossing. Cross both bridges and stand at the LEFT end of the seaward (south-east) rail so Futagojima sits centre-right; at 15:22 the sun is WSW at about 28°, behind your right shoulder, lighting the vermilion rather than flattening it. Then the frame nobody takes: mid-way on the inner bridge, shoot straight DOWN between your shoes through the lattice. Then look up for the zodiac.
correctedFromSeed: Genzo's gyutan korokke is ¥400, not the seed's ¥350 (the shop's own site), and its kaki chowder is 夏季休止中 while the grilled oysters at ¥300-400 are seasonal (day2-matsushima 62aaa38bb809).

Pensee's oyster curry bread is ¥380, not ¥300, and THE SHOP IS NOT ON THE GODAIDO APPROACH: it is on the 1F of Matsushima Rikyu Umi-no-Eki at 町内75-14, about 200 m from the cruise pier, 10:00-17:00 daily, 不定休 (3cbd10a22c0e).

Matsushima Kamaboko Honpo opens 9:30, not 09:00; its hand-grilling counter is ¥400 a stick rather than the seed's ¥300; and PARTIES OF 10 OR MORE MUST PRE-BOOK it — which for 35 people means a phone call weeks out, not turning up (16b64d767bbf, d2god001matsukama).

THE FIX FOR THAT, added: Abe Kamaboko's own Matsushima Teramachi branch at 松島町内58 does 手焼き笹かま体験 at 1枚300円(税込), about 10 minutes, and 「予約は不要です」 — the grill 35 people can actually walk into, three minutes from here toward the pier. Its 9:00-18:00 hours are Miyagi Navi's rather than the operator's and no closing day is published anywhere, so it is medium (topup-misc tmisc-abe-matsu, tmisc-abe-teyaki).

The seed also implies the fresh sasakamaboko can be taken home. It cannot: fresh kamaboko is chilled, only the vacuum-packed shelf-stable line flies, and which packs are which is not stated on Matsukama's site.

Added the only room at Godaido that can sit a coach party down, which the seed does not have: Gyutan Sumiyaki Rikyu Matsushima Godaido at 町内112-2, 年中無休, lunch 10:30-15:00 then 15:00-19:00 with L.O. 18:30, fifty seats on 1F plus group seating upstairs with a bay view (d2god002rikyu).

Added two paid neighbours: Kanrantei and the Matsushima Museum at 町内56, two minutes, Apr-Oct 08:30-17:00, 無休, ¥300 adult and ¥250 at 30+, with tea from ¥500 on top — a Fushimi-Momoyama tea pavilion Hideyoshi gave Masamune; and Fukuurabashi, the 252 m vermilion bridge four minutes east, ¥300 adult, 08:30-17:00 — bridge out and back is about 20 minutes of a 30-minute stop, so it is the bridge and the island gate, not the island loop (d2w30gda, d2w30gdb).

Matsushima Bay Cruise — Nioumaru course.do: 16:00 IS THE LAST SAILING and there is nothing behind it. Eight departures hourly 09:00-16:00, 50 minutes each, on the operator's own 通年 timetable; the 16:00 berths 16:50 against a 17:00 coach — ten minutes, no slack upstream. THE BOARDING CALL DOES NOT FIT THE PRINTED PLAN: board by 15:50, but Godaido runs 15:22 for 30 minutes and the pier is 280 m / 5 min on, so leave Godaido about 15:45. The 「16:00の便が休航」 note is WINTER-only, when sunset is early; 9 Sep sunset is 17:54.
Matsushima Bay Cruise — Nioumaru course.eat: Buy before you board: the boat's own catering is minimal. Matsushima Kushiya does long skewers loaded with gyutan, 10:00-17:00 — LOCATION CORRECTED: 1F of Matsushima Rikyu Umi-no-Eki, about 200 m and three minutes from the pier, not opposite it, and 17:00 is the minute the coach leaves. The typhoon fallback that seats a group is Kaki Matsushima Kouha's Sky Restaurant, in front of the pier, 11:00-17:00, closed MONDAYS so open Wednesday: fried oyster set ¥2,200, fried-and-grilled ¥2,900.
Matsushima Bay Cruise — Nioumaru course.snack: Abe Kamaboko's Matsushima Teramachi branch at 町内58 — 手焼き笹かま at ¥300 tax-in, about ten minutes at the grill, 「予約は不要です」, which is the difference from Matsukama's 10-or-more pre-booking rule. But DO IT INSIDE THE GODAIDO HALF-HOUR on the way past, not at the pier: boarding is called at 15:50 and there is no second boat. Otherwise Kushiya's gyutan skewers at the Umi-no-Eki, three minutes off the direct line. Fresh kamaboko is chilled and will not fly, so it is eaten on the spot.
Matsushima Bay Cruise — Nioumaru course.buy: THE FARE IS CORRECTED: 「団体（15名以上）1割引」 gives ¥1,350 adult for a 35-person party, not the seed's flat ¥1,500 — about ¥5,250 saved, and it is published on the operator's own fare table rather than something to 'ask' about. Child ¥750. Then the purchase that changes the photographs: the 2F 展望デッキ グリーン upgrade, +¥600 adult, +¥300 child, infants free — the open upper deck of the 第二仁王丸 instead of a glassed-in cabin. The supplement is NOT discounted.
Matsushima Bay Cruise — Nioumaru course.see: Nio-jima, the wave-cut rock the course is named for, said to look like a temple guardian smoking a pipe, on the outer turn about 20 minutes out; Kanejima, pierced by four surf-cut caves, the most photographed islet on the loop; and Futagojima, 600 m off the pier, so the first islet and the shot everybody gets before the deck fills. Take the PORT (left) rail a third back from the bow: the sun sits due west at 22° for all 50 minutes, so from port you shoot north and east with light behind you.
correctedFromSeed: THE GROUP FARE IS ¥1,350, not ¥1,500. 「団体（15名以上）1割引」 is on the operator's own fare table, so the seed's 'groups of 15 or more get 10% off the adult fare, so ask' understates it — the discount is published, and it is about ¥5,250 across 35 people. The Green supplement is not discounted (essentials.groupRate, notes2 §1).

THE BOARDING CALL COLLIDES WITH GODAIDO, and neither the seed nor the app says so: boarding is 15:50 while Godaido is 15:22 for 30 minutes and the pier is 280 m / 5 minutes on — so the group must leave Godaido at about 15:45 and the real Godaido stop is 23 minutes (essentials.transport against the app's Day 2 times).

Matsushima Kushiya is NOT 'directly opposite the pier': it is on the 1F of Matsushima Rikyu Umi-no-Eki, about 200 m and three minutes away, and it shuts at 17:00 — the same minute the coach leaves, which is sharper than the seed's 'soon after the last cruise returns' (2e5d5567ff7b).

Kanejima's coordinate is DOWNGRADED from the seed's 'verified' to unconfirmed: the GSI gazetteer returns no entry at all for 鐘島. Nio-jima's was corrected by about 3.5 km to the gazetteer point 38.3281, 141.0869 in Shiogama waters off the Urato islands (680c2696e33b, 7dac0410cca7).

The seed's confidenceNote asks for a scrubbed-cruise fallback and names only the Zuiganji museum or Entsuin. The better one is at the pier: Kaki Matsushima Kouha's Sky Restaurant at 磯崎75-14, directly in front of the 遊覧船乗り場, 11:00-17:00 Tue-Fri, closed Mondays, oysters year-round at ¥2,200-2,900 — it seats a group and it is open on a Wednesday (d2cru002kouha).

Added Futagojima, gazetteer-verified at 38.3646, 141.0646 about 600 m off the pier — the first islet of the loop, and also visible from the Godaido seaward rail thirty minutes earlier, which makes it the day's easiest before-and-after pair (d2cru001futago).

Added the after-17:00 reality the seed omits: every shop in Matsushima closes at 17:00, and the only things still trading are FamilyMart Matsushima Kaigan-dori at 普賢堂32-4 — 24 hours, 22 free parking spaces so the coach can pull in, ATM, toilets, five eat-in seats — and Matsushima Kaigan Station six minutes from the pier, which is also the escape route to Sendai in 40 minutes (d2w30bcb, d2w30bca).

The typhoon risk the seed flags is the operator's own words — 「台風などにより安全が確保できない場合は運航中止とさせていただきます」 — and cancellation by phone, fax or email before the previous day's close carries NO fee (essentials.closedNote, phoneNote).

Ginzan Onsen Street.do: MISSION 1, the banner photo, in the FIRST TWENTY MINUTES on Shirogane Bridge: the only level ground wide enough for 35 people plus a 240x100 cm banner, because the street beyond is 4-5 m wide with the river down the middle — and by 11:00 the day-trip coaches make it the worst choke point here. Then the 400 m car-free street and five minutes to Shirogane Falls. NO VEHICLE ENTERS THE STREET, coaches included: it waits at Taisho Roman-kan (10 bays, 08:30-17:30), shuttle ¥500. Get-back-by 11:25.
Ginzan Onsen Street.eat: Standing-eat namaage at Nogawa Toufuya, 銀山新畑427, ¥250, CASH ONLY — thick fried tofu, and it OPENS 08:30, not the seed's 07:30, closing when the handmade batch sells out; standing tofu ¥210, tofu-ten ¥250, tel 0237-28-2494. Izunohana at 銀山新畑440 is the only house on the street serving the tempura soba the app promises at 12:00 — 11:00-18:00, L.O. 17:30, closed WEDNESDAYS so open Thursday — but 11:00 is the last 30 minutes of the stop, and lunch is a coach transfer away.
Ginzan Onsen Street.snack: Two named ones, both by Shirogane Bridge, both eaten hot on the spot. Nogawa Toufuya's ¥250 namaage, cash only, from 08:30. And Haikara-san no Curry Pan at about ¥250 — the maker's own shop はいからさん通り closed to relocate, and the line now sells at Kashidokoro Meiyu-an (銀山新畑438-2, 08:00-17:30, tel 0237-28-2588) AND at Taisho Roman-kan where the coach parks, which opens 09:00 against a 09:30 arrival. Karinto-manju is fried to order at Meiyu-an's counter. Neither travels.
Ginzan Onsen Street.buy: A hand-painted kokeshi from Izu Kokeshi Kobo on the street, 08:30-17:30: finished pieces from about ¥1,100, or paint-your-own at ¥540-1,080 including the blank, 20-25 minutes, which fits a two-hour stop — telephone ahead for a group, the bench is small. Wooden, unbreakable in a case, no shelf life, no customs question. CORRECTION: the karinto-manju box is NOT the flight souvenir the seed calls it — the maker prices 6 at ¥900, not ¥790, and ships it FROZEN: 90 days at -18°C, three thawed.
Ginzan Onsen Street.see: From mid-bridge, the double row of three- and four-storey wooden ryokan facing each other across the Ginzan river, with Notoya Ryokan's kote-e plasterwork facade and rooftop lookout tower on the right — shot from the LEFT bank walkway opposite and framed VERTICALLY, because the street is 4-5 m wide and that is the working distance. At the far end Shirogane Falls drops 22 m and splits in two. SEPTEMBER IS DEEP GREEN, dark timber and grey-green river: no snow, no autumn colour, no illumination.
correctedFromSeed: THE FOOTBATH'S NAME IS WARASHIYU. 和楽足湯 is read わらしゆ — Obanazawa City prints the furigana 「和楽足湯(わらしゆ)」 — so 足湯 is folded into a compression pun rather than read separately, and the seed's 'Waraku Ashiyu' is the naive character-by-character reading. The kanji it holds is right; the romanisation is not. Unchanged: 06:00-22:00, free, source-fed, on the river by Shirogane Bridge, and BRING YOUR OWN TOWEL because nothing on the street sells one (topup-misc correction to 70e89c03f9e4).

Nogawa Toufuya opens 08:30, not the seed's 07:30 (Rurubu: 「8時30分～売り切れ次第終了」). The conflict is recorded rather than resolved: Yamagata Prefecture's own page lists the shop closed MONDAYS with a ¥160 cotton-tofu pack as its only product. Thursday is unaffected either way (843768da18f4).

KARINTO-MANJU IS NOT SHELF-STABLE and ¥790 is stale. The maker's own shop lists 6 for ¥900, 10 for ¥1,470, 12 for ¥1,760, 16 for ¥2,330, with 賞味期限90日間 at -18℃ and three days once thawed — so the seed's 'shelf-stable and ideal for carrying back to Malaysia' is wrong. Buy it hot at the counter (f3d29551b6bd).

Yagihashi Shoten's tastings start at ¥300, not ¥500, and its bottles run ¥450-1,890 direct from Yamagata breweries; 銀山新畑448, 08:30-18:00, no closing day, tel 0237-28-2035. A bottle is over the 100 ml cabin limit, so checked baggage only, against 25 kg and five more shopping days (06a9959f36e3).

The curry pan's home is settled: はいからさん通り is a SHOP, not a street; it closed to relocate; and Yamagata Prefecture's official tourism site says 「購入は明友庵又は大正ろまん館でどうぞ」 — including the coach lot, which opens 09:00 (topup-misc d3shopcurry1).

The coach question the seed leaves open is answered: no vehicle enters the street, the transfer is at Taisho Roman-kan (10 coach bays plus 100 cars, lot 08:30-17:30, building 09:00-17:30), the ¥500 on-demand shuttle is run by Ginzanso on 080-9283-2268, and the WINTER park-and-ride ENDED 1 March 2026 with no 2026-27 period announced, so it does not apply on 10 September (essentials.transport, notes3 §2).

Added the ¥7,000 two-hour official Ginzan guide, booked through Obanazawa City Tourism and Products Association on 0237-23-4567 at least two weeks ahead — two hours is exactly this stop's length (essentials.groupRate).

Added what the widened radius bought above the street, all free: the 銀鉱洞, a lit walkable 17th-century silver working 15 minutes past the falls, open in September and closed only from first snow to yama-biraki — the thing the name Ginzan refers to; the 夏しらず坑 cold-air adit locals call 天然のクーラー; the 疎水坑 drip tunnel; せことい橋, where both falls show at once; and 籟音の滝, with the only tables above the street. こうもり穴 is 通行止め and Wamoyou is closed Thursdays (d3ginzanmine1, d3w30gin01-05, d3w30gin12).

Takimikan's Sobadokoro Takimitei — the one place you look DOWN on the ryokan rows — is CLOSED THURSDAYS and opens 11:00 anyway, against an 11:30 departure. Treat the ten-minute climb as a viewpoint only (d3w30gin13).

Zao Fox Village.do: THE PRINTED PLAN OVERRUNS THE GATE. The operator's summer hours are 09:00-16:30 with LAST ADMISSION 16:00, and the coach is scheduled out at 16:40 — ten minutes after closing — so the real stop is 80 MINUTES, NOT 90: board at 16:30, call the regroup about 16:15. ¥1,500 for middle school and up, free below, CASH ONLY at the window: ¥52,500 in notes for 35, no group rate published, no booking taken. Closed Wednesdays, so Thursday 10 Sep is a normal open day. 750 spaces, tel 0224-24-8812.
Zao Fox Village.eat: Nothing, and that IS the stop: no restaurant, and food is banned in the enclosure because the foxes lunge for it — nothing edible in your hands except at the elevated feeding platform, the one place feeding is allowed, because feeding elsewhere teaches them to jump at people. The nearest pairing is the soft-serve at Zao Dairy Centre's Cheese House, and with a 16:30 boarding call that is a coach decision, not a walk. Dinner is 18:00, about 30 minutes away.
Zao Fox Village.snack: Genuinely none, and the rule is why: no kiosk, no restaurant, and food or drink in the hands is forbidden outside the feeding platform. The 30-minute walking radius returned exactly ONE record — 弥治郎こけし村, 4.2 km straight line and 6-7 km by mountain road — so it is a coach add-on, not a walk. Bring water aboard beforehand: 590 m altitude, humid, no shade but the path. And the animal smell gets into fabric, so plan to change before the 18:00 dinner rather than after it.
Zao Fox Village.buy: The entrance shop by reception, and it is the ONLY counter here that takes cards — the ¥1,500 admission is cash. Plush foxes and keyrings are the group buy and they fly home fine; budget about ¥1,000 a head, because no price list is published anywhere. Two warnings worth repeating: the shop also stocks REAL FUR, which some colleagues will not want handed to them, and photography inside is prohibited. IT SHUTS WITH THE PARK AT 16:30, so shop before the last circuit, not after it.
Zao Fox Village.see: From the upper path, down into the hollow where dozens of foxes lie out in the afternoon sun. The gradient is the point: it gives eye-level frames without crouching, which the operator forbids because 'spending a long time at eye level with the foxes is dangerous, as they may gather and act aggresively towards you'. Shoot downhill ACROSS the slope so the WSW sun at about 31° rakes them, and keep walking between frames. SEPTEMBER IS MOULTING: thin patchy coats, unlike the winter photographs.
correctedFromSeed: The seed flags the closing conflict; the batch settles the sourcing behind it. The operator prints 「9:00~16:30(最終入場16:00) 夏季営業」, and Miyagi Prefecture, Shiroishi City, Zao Town and Jalan all put 10 September inside the summer period. Every page still showing 09:00-17:00 and ¥1,000 — Shiroishi City tourism, Miyagi DMO, Discover SENDAI, Jalan — is STALE, and that stale 17:00 is very likely where a 16:40 departure came from (essentials, notes3 §1).

Added the cash arithmetic the seed's 'Admission ¥1,500, cash' leaves implicit: ¥52,500 in notes for 35 people, NO group rate published, no reservation required or accepted, and the shop is the only card counter on site (essentials.groupRate, tickets).

The fox-holding experience is RESOLVED as unavailable, which the seed leaves open: 11:00 and 14:00 only, about 5 minutes, ¥1,000 cash, against a 15:10 arrival — brief it on the coach rather than letting 35 people queue at a closed counter. Medium only: the operator's own notice page is robots-blocked to us, so phone 0224-24-8812 (d3zaohug1, notes3 §4).

Added the elevated feeding platform as the single place feeding is allowed, with the operator's own reason — feeding anywhere else teaches the foxes to jump at people — and it is also the one frame where foxes look up at the camera instead of away (d3zaofeed1).

Added the small-animal section (rabbits, miniature horses, goats, guinea pigs) outside the free-roam enclosure — the answer for anyone in 35 who will not walk among loose foxes but does not want 80 minutes on the coach. Photography is banned there too (d3zaosmall1).

Added the operator's own wording behind the rules, which is what makes a group keep them: the no-crouching reason above, and 「Foxes have the tendency to break and bury objects they find on the ground, so make sure not to drop anything」 — so a phone on a wrist strap is a phone in a hole (notes3 §4, outfitByStop).

THE WALKING RADIUS IS EMPTY, and saying so is the answer. One record inside reach: 弥治郎こけし村 at 白石市福岡八宮字弥治郎北72-1, free entry, paint-your-own kokeshi ¥850 including the blank, 09:00-17:00 Apr-Oct, closed Wednesdays — filed with a bus leg because it is 4.2 km away (d3w30zao01, ITINERARY_CHANGE.md §6).
The Castle-kun community bus runs TUESDAYS AND FRIDAYS ONLY, so on a Thursday the coach is the only way in or out and nobody can make their own way back (essentials.transport).

Goshikinuma Ponds.do: BE REALISTIC ABOUT THE HOUR: the visitor centre's own figure for the Goshikinuma Shizen Tanshoro is about 4 km and 1h10-1h30 ONE WAY, so from the east trailhead 10:00-11:00 buys Bishamon-numa and little else. Walk the paved barrier-free path five minutes to the first deck and rowboat pier, then a little of the north-shore boardwalk. Free, ungated, never closes. Day 4 now leaves the hotel at 08:00 after a 07:00 breakfast against a ~2 h / ~130 km run, so a late start comes out of this hour.
Goshikinuma Ponds.eat: The turquoise 'Goshikinuma' soft-serve from the kiosk at the east trailhead plaza — bright pond-blue, not matcha, and the standard group-photo prop. The plaza runs 09:00-16:30 every day (無休, tel 0241-32-2349), so a 10:00 arrival is safe; cash is the sensible assumption at a trailhead kiosk and no price is published anywhere. Today's 12:00 lunch is a ceramic-plate beef or chicken set about 1h10 down the road, so this is a taste, not a meal.
Goshikinuma Ponds.snack: The soft-serve at the trailhead plaza, 09:00-16:30, and it is the only thing sold here — there is nothing at all on the trail, and no toilets past the trailhead either. Take water at the plaza too: at 820 m this is the coolest stop of the day at roughly 22-25°C, but the humidity is unchanged, mosquitoes and horseflies are still active, and the visitor centre notes BEARS. Free 24-hour toilets at the trailhead, and the next stop is 1h10 of coach away.
Goshikinuma Ponds.buy: BE HONEST WITH THE GROUP: the east trailhead plaza where the coach stops sells maps and postcards, and the Urabandai Visitor Centre has NO SHOP AT ALL. Aizu yama-shio — salt boiled down from Oshio Urabandai hot-spring brine, dry, sealed, indefinite shelf life, one of the few Day 4 buys that survives four more coach days and a flight — is at Urabandai Bussankan at the WEST end, 09:00-17:00 daily, tel 0241-32-3751, seasonal to mid-November. The ~¥450 is the seed's and unverified.
Goshikinuma Ponds.see: Bishamon-numa from the first deck: largest of the twenty-odd ponds, cobalt-emerald from suspended volcanic minerals rather than foliage — which is why this stop works on 11 September when nothing has turned — with Mt Bandai's blown-out crater wall behind it. Stand at the LEFT (south) end of the deck rail facing SOUTH-WEST so the crater fills the top third; the right end puts a tree in it. Before noon the sun is behind you, so faces are front-lit. STAY ON THE BOARDWALK — 「コースの外には出ないようにしましょう」.
correctedFromSeed: The seed's '3.6-4 km and 90 minutes one way' is refined by the visitor centre's own figure of about 4 km and 1h10-1h30 one way. Its conclusion — Bishamon-numa and little else — stands (day4-aizu essentials.transport).

Its west-end alternative becomes concrete rather than a suggestion: the route bus links 五色沼入口 and 裏磐梯高原駅 in about SEVEN MINUTES, roughly hourly, and the group's own coach can do the same — which puts Yanagi-numa 3 minutes in, Ao-numa 18, Ruri-numa 21 and Benten-numa 30, i.e. four blue ponds in the same hour (expand-d34 d4w30gos04-07, notes-expand-d34 §1.5).

THE PARKING IS TWO LOTS AND ONLY ONE TAKES A COACH. The seed's 92-space car park is the 五色沼入口観光プラザ; the Urabandai Visitor Centre publishes its own 普通車70台・大型バス5台・身障者用3台, usable 24 hours with free 24-hour toilets including an accessible one. The five large-bus bays are at the Visitor Centre — that is the number the driver needs (d4goshiplaza, 51fcab58541f, notes4 §4g).

Added the Visitor Centre's calendar, which the seed's 'no shop at all' line half-implies: 09:00-17:00 April-November, closed TUESDAYS (open if the Tuesday is a holiday, shut the next day) — so Friday 11 Sep is open (51fcab58541f).

Added the rowboat with its honest cost: hand-rowed boats on Bishamon-numa beside the first deck, running except in winter, but a 30-minute commitment out of a 60-minute stop — a sub-group option, and the association publishes no hours, price or operator (d4goshiboat0).

THE DALI COLLECTION NEXT DOOR IS SHUT: the Morohashi Museum of Modern Art is closed for renovation from 10 November 2025 until about April 2027, so nobody should walk over expecting the ¥1,300 galleries, and its car park and lakeside grounds are not a substitute (d4w30gos03, notes-expand-d34 §1.1).

Tsuruga Castle (Tsurugajo).do: MISSION 3 IS SHOT BEFORE ANYONE BUYS A TICKET, because the Honmaru lawn is free and the light is right at 13:15-13:35 rather than 14:20. 13:10 off the coach at Tsurugajo Kaikan, 8 minutes in; 13:18-13:40 the photo from the south-east corner looking WNW; 13:40 buy the ¥360 group ticket (30-99 people against ¥410 individually — about ¥1,750 saved at 35); 13:45-14:20 the keep, five floors, no lift, one-way stairs; 14:20-14:32 the Rokabashi bridge; back by 14:35. 08:30-17:00, last entry 16:30, 無休.

Tsurugajo Kaikan at the north gate, where the coach parks, does Aizu sauce katsudon (pork), wappa-meshi and Kitakata ramen; ask the guide about kozuyu, the dried-scallop soup in a shallow lacquer dish. No page prints its prices.
Tsuruga Castle (Tsurugajo).snack: Thin, and it is a tea rather than street food: Rinkaku's ¥600 matcha and jouyo-manju, ordered by 16:00, inside the park. Tsurugajo Kaikan at the coach bay (追手町4-47, 09:30-17:00 from 11 April to 10 November, tel 0242-28-2288) has the restaurants, the souvenir hall, handmade gelato and the last toilets. WE HOLD NO RECORD OF A STALL ON THE HONMARU LAWN, which is almost entirely unshaded — so fill water bottles at the Kaikan on the way IN, 8 minutes before the photo, not on the way out.
Tsuruga Castle (Tsurugajo).buy: Tsurugajo Kaikan's souvenir hall, where the coach already is — budget about ¥2,000 a head. Real maker prices: Nozawa Mingei akabeko ¥2,255 for a No.1, then ¥2,530, ¥2,915, ¥3,685, with a pin at ¥385 and a magnet at ¥550 for colleague gifts; okiagari-koboshi ¥160 for the 3.5 cm and ¥385 for the 6.5 cm, so a family of four is about ¥800 — tradition is one per family member plus a spare. Papier-mâché: light but crushable, so hand luggage. Aizu lacquerware and Hongo-yaki are the other named lines.
Tsuruga Castle (Tsurugajo).see: The keep itself — five tiers of white plaster under akagawara tiles relaid in 2011, the only red-tiled castle keep in Japan. For the group frame stand in the SOUTH-EAST corner of the Honmaru lawn facing WNW, back row 35-40 m out from the stone base, camera 12-15 m behind: at 13:15 the sun is SW at azimuth 220°, altitude 50° — BEHIND the keep — so expose for faces and add fill flash, and do not drift round to due east. Then the free Rokabashi bridge for the fan-sloped ogi-no-kobai wall.
correctedFromSeed: THE SEED'S SAKE GEOGRAPHY IS WRONG BOTH WAYS. Miyaizumi Meijo is not 'next to the castle': GSI puts 東栄町8番7号 about 340 m and 5 minutes from the Tsurugajo Kaikan COACH BAY and roughly 600 m from the keep. Fixed departures at 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, 15:00 and 16:00 March-November, 「団体様は要予約」, closed the 2nd Wednesday so open on the 11th — and 1.2 km / about 18 minutes each way, which is 38 minutes of a 90-minute stop before you see anything. Café 蔵喫茶 杏 10:00-16:30, L.O. 16:00, tel 0242-27-0002 (7d9f3decc2be, notes4 §4c).

THE PRESERVE THE SEED RECOMMENDS DOES NOT TRAVEL. Boxed nishin no sansho-zuke ships 「冷蔵便」 with 「出荷日より14日」 — refrigerated, 14 days — against four more coach days and a 7-hour flight. The version that flies is 会津高砂屋's 「にしん 山椒漬 ドライ 70g 864円（税込）」, or its three-kind assortment at ¥1,188 (8cf52a1d9c2e, d4shopdryhrr, notes4 §4h).

Rinkaku's tea service starts at 08:30 and runs to 16:00 on the tourism bureau's own notice; the seed gives the ¥600 and the 16:00 cut-off but not the opening (d8d4384afd4d).

MISSION 3 HAS NO RAIN PLAN IN THE SEED and the Honmaru lawn has no cover of any kind. The declared answer is the building the coach is already parked at — Tsurugajo Kaikan, 20 LARGE-BUS bays plus 100 cars, backed against the souvenir-hall wall rather than the glazed frontage, at zero transfer cost. Secondary, if the keep must stay in shot: the Minamihashiri-Nagaya, the only roofed space inside the castle, about 18 m by 2.5 m, so TWO rows maximum (d4w30tsu02, d4msrainfall, d4tsuruganag).

Added the free things around the paid keep that the seed does not carry: Tsurugajo Inari-jinja's vermilion torii tunnel and 600-year-old zelkova between the north gate and the Honmaru, the Kojo-no-Tsuki monument, Kita-demaru and the Ote-mon site 12 minutes round the moat, and a free 2 km / 30-minute inner-moat lap that is shaded most of the way in mid-September (d4w30tsu04-07).

Fukushima Prefectural Museum, 4 minutes from the coach bay in the Sannomaru, is the wet-weather plan on paper — 09:30-17:00, last entry 16:30, ¥400 adult and free for all school students, closed Mondays so open on the 11th — but its galleries want 60-90 minutes, which this slot does not have alongside the castle (d4w30tsu01).

Ouchi-juku.do: HALF THIS SLOT IS AFTER THE VILLAGE SHUTS, so the order is everything. The association's own line is 「午前9時から午後4時位まで」, and the kitchens close earlier still: Kintaro Soba 15:00 or when the soba runs out, Yamagataya 15:30, Minatoya L.O. 15:30, Misawaya 16:00. So walk the 500 m of thatch first, EAT BY 15:30, buy before 16:00, climb the Miharashidai last from about 15:45. Street and lookout are free. Coach park is 大型バス ¥3,000 cash, 到着順, 「予約は受け付けておりません」 — no reservation possible.
Ouchi-juku.eat: TWO CORRECTIONS. Misawaya has NO closing day — its own site prints 定休日「なし」 and 営業時間「午前9時30分～午後4時」, tel 0241-68-2927 — which makes it the only soba house still serving after 15:30 and the fallback if the group runs late, not the one to write off. And Minatoya is 10:30-16:00 with LAST ORDERS 15:30, not 09:30-17:00, at 大内山本34. Takato negi-soba, eaten with a whole raw spring onion for chopsticks, is ¥1,500 at Misawaya in a 350-year-old farmhouse, ¥1,250 cash-only at Yamagataya.
Ouchi-juku.snack: Minatoya's shingoro — half-pounded rice on a skewer under perilla-miso, charcoal-grilled — taken standing, and it has to happen by 15:30 because that is its last order. Man'ya's stick-grilled iwana char at about ¥550, salted around an irori hearth, is the other quick one and the smell carries down the street — but Man'ya publishes nothing, so its hours, closing days and that price are uncorroborated. Send four or five at a time: there is no queue management for 35. Cash; no ATM here.
Ouchi-juku.buy: Kintaro Soba Yamamotoya's SOUVENIR side, 09:30-16:00 — it stays open after its 15:00 soba kitchen shuts, which is what makes it reachable in this slot. Its own listed best-seller is three-year miso, 1,300 g, fermented and sealed so it travels: about ¥1,500, no counter price published. Also dried kurumi-soba and Aizu wild oni-gurumi walnuts; kurumi soba in the restaurant is ¥1,550, tel 0241-68-2912. DO NOT PACK the boxed nishin no sansho-zuke (冷蔵, 14 days) or Yamato-ya's fresh tochi-daifuku.
Ouchi-juku.see: The unbroken double line of thatch with open water channels down both sides, from the Miharashidai looking SOUTH so the rows converge away from you — free, always open, up the stone steps behind Koyasu Kannon-do, 20-25 minutes round trip from the top of the street, 14 each way from the coach park. Take the LEFT end of the rail: the centre puts the modern car park dead-centre far off. Best light of the trip — the sun falls from 37° at 14:40 to 14° at 16:40, golden from 16:00. Skip in rain.
correctedFromSeed: KINTARO SOBA YAMAMOTOYA IS OPEN ON FRIDAY 11 SEPTEMBER. The seed's 'closed Thursdays AND Fridays, so it will be shut on 11 September' is wrong: the shop is 不定休 on its own site and five independent listings, and it publishes September's actual closures as 2, 3, 4, 8, 10, 17, 18, 24, 25 and 30 — the 11th is not among them. MISAWAYA HAS NO CLOSING DAY. The seed says 'usually closed Wednesdays'; the operator's own site prints 定休日「なし」. The seed's conclusion that it is open survives, but the reasoning inverts — it is the LAST kitchen serving, to 16:00, and therefore the late-running fallback (f7248e95eb9c, notes4 §4b).
AJIDOKORO MINATOYA IS 10:30-16:00 with L.O. 15:30, not the seed's 09:30-17:00 — fifty minutes into a slot that runs to 16:40, which is exactly why eating goes at the front (f3ae598d5f82, notes4 §4e).

Yamagataya is 「AM 9:00〜PM 3:30」 and it is the only house here with a published GROUP menu: 10 to 50 people, sets ¥1,700-¥2,800 a head, CASH ONLY, everyone on the same set, 「急なご予約はお受けできません」. A perfect fit for 35 people and completely wasted, because it shuts 50 minutes after the coach arrives (544e6b9d8704, notes4 §4i).

Man'ya is the weakest record of the day: it publishes nothing of its own and the aggregator listings for it are empty templates, so the ~¥550 iwana, its hours and its closing days are all uncorroborated (cf52295ef726).

THE ONE THING THAT OUTLIVES THE 16:00 CLOSE, added: the Ouchi-juku Machinami Exhibition Hall, the rebuilt honjin at mid-street with irori, dirt floor, Edo furnishings and the lord's own separate entrance — 09:00-16:30, ¥250/¥150 and ¥200/¥100 at 30+, closed only 29 Dec-3 Jan. It is the only paid attraction still open in the back half of this slot (d4w30ouc01, notes-expand-d34 §1.6).

The boxed nishin no sansho-zuke the seed calls 'the village preserve that actually travels' does not: 「冷蔵便」, 「出荷日より14日」. Buy 会津高砂屋's dried 70 g at ¥864 instead (8cf52a1d9c2e, d4shopdryhrr, notes4 §4h).

Added two frames nobody takes and one name correction: the paddy lane west of the village, where the whole thatched row photographs from level ground with no cars and no crowd, the rice heavy and turning gold in mid-September; and Takakura-jinja's torii of unfinished unpainted timber standing in the middle of the street — it is the ONLY shrine at Ouchi-juku, so any mention of a 湯殿神社 here is wrong, and its 半夏まつり is 2 July (d4w30ouc02-04, notes-expand-d34 §1.7).

Two more houses named against the same 15:30-16:00 wall: Ishihara-ya at 大内山本5 does ume-oroshi soba and whisked matcha, 09:30-15:30, 不定休; and Ouchi-juku Shoku-no-Yakata at 大内1053, on the approach below the preserved street, 09:00-16:00, closed MONDAYS and shut 1 Dec-31 Mar (d4w30ouc05, d4w30ouc07).

Hotel Kameya, Naruko Onsen.do: THIS STOP IS NO LONGER ON THE ITINERARY: night 2 was superseded on the 4 September 2026 app screenshots and is now Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Kounkaku, at 字車湯17 against Kameya's 車湯54-6 — GSI resolves both to the IDENTICAL point, so the Naruko town research below transfers unchanged and only on-property detail is retired. Kameya: 50 rooms, check-in 15:00, tel 0229-83-2211, its 黒湯 (塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉) across three baths — valley-view tenbo daiyokujo, hinoki, source-fed rotenburo.
Hotel Kameya, Naruko Onsen.eat: Dinner was the hotel kaiseki at 19:00 after an 18:30 check-in. The town item worth keeping is Mochidokoro Fukase's kuri-dango by the station — a whole syrup-steeped chestnut inside mochi under sweet walnut-miso sauce, the same recipe for over a century, ¥400 for two, 09:00-17:00 with irregular closing days. IT OPENS AT 09:00 AGAINST AN 08:30 COACH, so it was always a guide-negotiated stop on the way out of town, not something anyone could walk to. 1 km from the door, about 14 minutes downhill.
Hotel Kameya, Naruko Onsen.snack: Nothing at the hotel and nothing in town at 22:00, and that is the honest answer — it is also the sharpest contrast with the replacement, where Lawson Osaki Naruko Onsen is 78 m from the door and 24 hours. From Kameya the bath town and station are 0.95-1.2 km, 13 to 17 minutes each way down and back up a gorge. Taki-no-Yu (¥300 from the machine, 07:30-21:00, last entry 20:30) sells NEITHER soap NOR towel and has no showers or taps, so both come from the room plus ¥300 in coins.
Hotel Kameya, Naruko Onsen.buy: A Naruko kokeshi from Sakurai Kokeshi-ten honten at 大崎市鳴子温泉字湯元26 — weekdays 10:00-17:00, weekends from 09:30, 不定休, tel 0229-87-3575, with the workshop behind the counter. Mini pieces about ¥2,640, a small ejiko or nemariko about ¥3,300. Naruko kokeshi are the strain whose head goes 「キュキュッ」 when you turn it, because head and body are turned separately on the lathe. Solid wood, so it flies — but wrap it, and note the shop opens 10:00, after the 08:30 coach.
Hotel Kameya, Naruko Onsen.see: The steam. Naruko vents sulphurous steam from roadside sources and the best free vantage is the stone stairway up to Naruko Onsen Shrine, founded 835, from Taki-no-Yu's entrance: climb two-thirds, then turn and shoot BACK DOWN the steps with the balustrade running out of the bottom-left corner and the tin roofs beyond. Free, no gate, any hour. Steam only reads in low light, so it is a 05:45-06:30 picture — sunrise 10 Sep about 05:15. NO AUTUMN COLOUR: Naruko-kyo peaks late October.

Okuiizaka Anabara Onsen Yoshikawaya.do: THIS STOP IS NO LONGER ON THE ITINERARY: night 3 was superseded on the 4 September 2026 app screenshots and MOVED PREFECTURE — Anabara Onsen in Fukushima to Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa in Miyagi — cutting the transfer from Zao Fox Village from about 1h05 / 45 km to 30 min / 18 km and pulling check-in to 17:15. The eggs' proper home is Aberu Shoten at 飯坂町湯野字橋本5, 08:00-19:00, tel 024-542-2680 — ¥980 for a ten-egg box of the red kind. DO NOT FLY THEM: 「発送日より2週間」 and cool-shipped in summer, and a soft-set egg is not hand luggage to Penang. The akabeko and the dry goods fly; the eggs do not.
Okuiizaka Anabara Onsen Yoshikawaya.see: The Surikami gorge below the two riverside open-air baths, Saruami-no-Yu and Kamoshika-no-Yu — the best view on the property, free, and unphotographable, because you cannot take a phone into a bath. The one real photograph in the area was Totsuna-bashi: a 51.7 m steel arch of 1915, among the oldest surviving Taisho arch bridges, floodlit nightly since 2009, free at any hour and working in rain — 2.7 km away by taxi. Sunset 17:54 against a 17:45 arrival, so NO daylight frame at the hotel at all.

Rates only by phone (essentials.groupRate).
